title: Der Weg zum Nicht-Selbst: Das Leben im Zentrum (publisher unconfirmed, year unconfirmed, German)
description: Listed as a German 'Taschenbuch' rendering of The Path to No-Self: Life at the Center. German-language Wikipedia mirrors (de.mgwiki.top, deutsch.wikibrief.org) list 'Der Weg zum Nicht-Selbst: Das Leben im Zentrum (1985)' with the SUNY 1991 reissue ISBN 0-7914-1142-7, i.e. a German gloss of the English title in a works list, not a German edition. No German publisher, year, ISBN or translator was found in Amazon.de, ZVAB, booklooker, eurobuch, medimops or Arbor results; the only German book translation found is Jenseits von Ego und Selbst (Arbor, 1997). Most likely the eBay item is the English SUNY/Shambhala paperback under a translated title. Update to an already-known lead.

title: Jenseits von Ego und Selbst: Erfahrungsbericht einer spirituellen Reise (Arbor Verlag, 2018, German, e-book)
description: Arbor Verlag e-book, 25 Jul 2018; ISBN 978-3-86781-222-1; 216 pp. (Amazon.de Kindle ASIN B07FVPMCN7). Translated from the American by Franz Loschnigg and Karin Hein. German translation of The Experience of No-Self (mapping inferred from subtitle and content; not stated by a source).

title: Jenseits von Ego und Selbst: Leseprobe / front matter (Arbor Verlag, German)
description: Publisher-hosted sample PDF (title page, contents, opening) of the Arbor Verlag German edition, ISBN 3-924195-27-7. Link only.

title: 自己喪失の体験 (紀伊國屋書店, 1989, Japanese)
description: Jiko sōshitsu no taiken. Kinokuniya Shoten, 1989; ISBN 4-314-00518-1 (978-4-314-00518-0); 182 pp., 20 cm. Translated by Amemiya Ichirō and Shiga Michi. Renders The Experience of No-Self. A later printing (c. 2005, 184 pp.) is reported by second-hand sellers.

title: 無我の体験 (ナチュラルスピリット, 2014, Japanese)
description: Muga no taiken (Kakusei Books series). Natural Spirit, 23 Oct 2014; ISBN 4-86451-140-3 (978-4-86451-140-7). New translation by Tachibana Arimi of The Experience of No-Self.

title: 無自己の体験 (ナチュラルスピリット, 2021, Japanese)
description: Mu-jiko no taiken: retitled reissue (2021) of 無我の体験 (2014), tr. Tachibana Arimi, Natural Spirit; list price 1,800 yen + tax. ISBN not found in this pass. Renders The Experience of No-Self. URL is a 2024 review blog post; publisher page not surfaced.

title: 自己とは何か (ナチュラルスピリット, 2021, Japanese)
description: Jiko to wa nanika (Kakusei Books). Natural Spirit, November 2021; ISBN 978-4-86451-382-1; 392 pp.; 2,100 yen + tax. Translated by Fukuda Karen. Renders What Is Self? A Study of the Spiritual Journey in Terms of Consciousness.

title: 무아의 경험 (unofficial partial translation, Daum cafe, Korean)
description: Unofficial, uncredited Korean rendering of the opening and part of chapter 1 of The Experience of No-Self, posted in a Daum cafe with the English alongside. No published Korean edition was found.

title: L'esperienza del non-sé (Astrolabio-Ubaldini, 1987, Italian)
description: Astrolabio-Ubaldini, Rome, collana Ulisse, May 1987; ISBN 88-340-0887-1 (978-88-340-0887-4); paperback (brossura), 168 pp. Renders The Experience of No-Self. Translator not named in retail listings found.

title: L'esperienza del non sè (Mondadori?, 1998, Italian) - library catalogue record
description: Istituto A.T. Beck library catalogue lists L'esperienza del non sè with publisher Mondadori, 1998. Not corroborated elsewhere; may be a cataloguing error for the Astrolabio 1987 edition or an unrecorded reprint.

title: De ervaring van het niet-zelf: Een contemplatieve tocht (Samsara, 2021, Dutch)
description: Uitgeverij Samsara, Amsterdam, 2021, 1st printing; ISBN 978-94-92995-91-9; hardback, 272 pp. Renders The Experience of No-Self: A Contemplative Journey. Translator given as Maurice Jacobs by the ongrond.nl review; retailers list Hester van Toorenburg as co-contributor (role unclear).

title: De ervaring van het niet-zelf (Samsara, 2021, Dutch, e-book)
description: EPUB edition, Samsara Uitgeverij b.v., 2021; ISBN 978-94-93228-08-5. Dutch translation of The Experience of No-Self.
